articles.title: Equal Pay Smash: Tennis Levels the Court for Men and Women
articles.summary: The WTA announced that all combined 1,000-level tennis events will award equal prize money to men and women starting next year. The Italian, Canadian, and Cincinnati Opens are now on board, joining the Grand Slams.

articles.title: VisionQuest Trailer Reveals Marvel's Most Mysterious Mercenary
articles.summary: Marvel's new series "VisionQuest" premieres October 14 on Disney+. The trailer introduces Paladin, a mercenary with almost no known backstory, who is hunting Vision for a bounty.

articles.title: Noah Kahan's Hunger Games Song Is About Grief and Hope
articles.summary: Noah Kahan released "Draw You Out," his song for the Hunger Games prequel "Sunrise on the Reaping." The track, co-produced by Aaron Dessner, arrives before the album drops November 13 and the film opens November 20.
